blocks.text: The Filinvest Group continued its record of strong corporate governance as its four publicly listed companies were once again recognized at the 2026 Golden Arrow Awards organized by the Institute of Corporate Directors (ICD). Filinvest Development Corporation (FDC) received two Golden Arrows, while Filinvest Land, Inc. (FLI) and Filinvest REIT Corp. (FILRT) each earned one Golden Arrow. EastWest Banking Corporation (EastWest) received three Golden Arrows, marking an increase from its two-Golden Arrow recognition in 2025. The latest distinctions build on the Group’s consistent recognition at the annual awards, reflecting its efforts to maintain sound governance practices across its businesses. “Being recognized […]...
